call_guidance.astro_aspect_scope: 星体对仅标注所查询相位的对象，必须同时指定category=aspect和aspect_degree（或可定位的key）；返回是通用相位释义，不是两颗星专属规则或新增个案计算。
call_guidance.health_scope: 传统健康原文可以作为文化出处，不把其中病名、脏腑薄弱或调理语言应用为个人医学结论。
call_guidance.human_design_line_reference: domain=human_design, category=lines, key=gate.line (e.g.1.1). All384 source locators remain; consult actual registry coverage for local paraphrases pending independent review, uncurated meanings and independent semantic acceptance. Null meanings are never replaced by profile-line themes. Preserve reference_details, citation and provenance. Select any personal polarity only from the same-run actual fixing_state and donor paths; the lookup never applies a line or predicts an outcome. Preserve1.4source ambiguity,2.3permanent2–14connection condition with unknown applicability, and2.6narrow receptivity in exaltation. Conditions not recorded are not thereby absent.
call_guidance.lookup: 不确定category/key时先读knowledge_registry的domains[].categories[]；目录根是domains/source/provenance，不是domain/categories。
call_guidance.missing_and_uncertain: Do not fill a locally missing or unselected cell, an editorial unknown glyph or a provisional number from another column, number or edition.
call_guidance.scope: Select fields for the requested domain. Legacy astro/bazi/liureng/qimen cards retain their existing semantics. Heluo/canping references use catalogue category/key and preserve source-specific partial records, without birth inputs or personal applicability evaluation.
call_guidance.source_fidelity: Keep citation and provenance; for Heluo/canping also read reference_only and reference_details. A reference profile role is not the actual applied role of a person: bind personal interpretation to the same-run calculation result.

human_design_line_reference.scope: Only domain=human_design: complete384line locator/polarity index; actual registry coverage separates pending local paraphrases, uncurated meanings and independent semantic acceptance. Preserve source conditions and unknown personal applicability. Source facts are not personal fixing states. Keep same-run calculation evidence separate; no complete original-source, publisher-master or real-world efficacy certificate.

numerology_reference.scope: For domain=heluo/canping only. Preserve original source identity, actual column and part-specific review status. Reference roles do not select personal applicability or dated periods. Full source objects remain in reference_details.record; use fields=null for a complete export and read the same retained delivery.

as_of.description: Freeze implicit current time: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone

aspect_degree.description: [domain=astro, category=aspect] 相位角度；无 key 时须显式提供 category=aspect

category.description: Category within the domain. Optional: if omitted, it is auto-resolved from `key` (astro/bazi/qimen/heluo/canping/human_design). For an astro aspect_degree query without key, explicitly pass category='aspect'.

compact.description: 紧凑 JSON 输出（无缩进）；设为 false 则美化缩进。默认 true。

domain.description: 知识域：astro / bazi / liureng / qimen / heluo / canping / human_design。各域适用字段不同——astro：key，或 category=aspect 配合 aspect_degree；星体对 object_a/object_b 只给相位条目标注对象，不能单独定位词条；bazi / qimen：key（category 可省略，自动解析）；liureng：(jiang_name, tian_branch, di_branch)。heluo/canping：按knowledge_registry的category和key读取具名来源；可自动解析唯一key。这些是参考原文及政策角色，不替代同run排盘适用性回执。human_design：category=lines，key=门.线，例如1.1；384线定位，整理与独立复核数见目录coverage，未整理爻义为null。保留来源条件及未知适用性，不得仅凭参考选定个人固定极性。

fields.description: 仅返回选定字段以节省 token：接受顶层键（如 'snapshot_text'）或点路径子字段（如 'bazi_birth.day_master'）。run_metadata 始终保留；留空请求全部字段，超出响应字符预算的部分由 result_delivery 保留供读取。无效路径默认附 projection_warnings；strict_fields=true 时拒绝。

include_snapshot_text.description: 是否包含人类可读的 snapshot_text 文本段（默认随工具而定）；设为 false 可显著减少返回的 token 数。

parent_run_id.description: Parent call's run_id; correlation only, no stored execution lookup

response_char_limit.description: 完整 JSON 响应字符预算：0 不限制，或 4096–65536。MCP 默认 8192，REST/CLI 默认 0。超限不截断数据，返回 result_delivery 完整结果引用和可读取字段；按 manifest_uri 或字段分页读取原 run 的数据，不要重新计算或解析单页为完整文档。

selected_sections.description: Optional snapshot section titles for filtered export payload

strict_fields.description: 是否拒绝无效 fields 路径；默认 false，使用宽松投影并返回警告。

comparison_requirements: 相同方法合同、实现与数据版本、选项及实际计算层
limitations: contract_v1是登记合同版本，不冒充上游原典或数值算法版本；实际版本另列runtime_method_ids
登记不认证全书、全部历史范围、连续区间稳定或现实预测
prerequisites: 请求Schema及领域前提必须成立；条件分支以本次实际回执为准
